name: Structure in view, detail one action away
principle: A person sees at a glance which solutions the AI is working on and what each sub-agent does there, and reaches a solution's fields and connections only by asking.
state_description: A short tree shows the hierarchy, each sub-agent on its solution with its state and latest activity; opening a solution shows its purpose, approach, metric and latest value, selected implementation and milestones, and its problems, ideals and delegates with their fields; closing it returns to the short tree.
hints_of_measurement: The hierarchy and the solution of each sub-agent are right; the collapsed view carries no field detail; the opened view carries the named fields and connections.
